service.description: The work policy in effect for one of the user's organizations (MAINTENANCE_SETTINGS_EDIT or any maintenance read; ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope), or the defaults when it has none (fromDate empty): approval threshold zero hours, a supervisor closes, no default type or team, production requests and warranty repairs not managed, no self-approval, no voice note transcription, and preventive work made on its day when a plan names no lead days (pmLeadDays, P14). planned: the policies set to start later (P18), in their order; ended: the last ten that ended, newest first (a withdrawn plan, ended at its own start, is in neither). canEdit says whether the user may change it.

An organization's work policy from fromDate, now when not given and never earlier (DATE_INVALID; P18) (MAINTENANCE_SETTINGS_EDIT; the organization in the user's scope), ending the row in effect then; a policy planned to start later refuses it (PLAN_PENDING, naming the plan's date) unless withdrawPlanned, which withdraws the plan (ended at its own start; the user's call of Nov 12) and one planned for that very time is changed in place. Each field not given is kept from the policy in effect at fromDate, so a call changes only what it names (P18). The approval threshold in hours (zero or more, VALUE_INVALID), the closure policy, the default maintenance type and team (a team the organization owns, TEAM_UNAVAILABLE), and whether its production requests and warranty repairs become managed work, whether a procedure's last author may approve it (procedureSelfApproval, off by default; impl-maintenance P6), and whether a checklist step's voice note is transcribed (voiceNoteTranscription, off by default; impl-maintenance P7 review).

parameter.name: pmLeadDays
parameter.description: The days ahead preventive work is made for a plan whose terms name none (P14; 0 to 365, empty: on the day)

service.description: Maintenance's lookups, a whitelist of Enumeration families: the vocabularies (work types, severities, hold and cancel reasons, outcomes, failure modes), whose values are added and ended, and the fixed kinds (kinds, sources, resource dispositions), renamed and reordered only; each family with its value count. With enumTypeId, its values in order, current unless includeEnded, each with how many records hold it (useCount), its end (stateText), its applicability (a failure mode's asset classes and models in effect, appliesText "All equipment" with none) and whether the caller may change and end it; with assetId, a failure mode applying to that equipment alone (the equipment in the caller's scope, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Read by a maintenance reader or MAINTENANCE_SETTINGS_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise); refuses another family (FAMILY_INVALID).

parameter.name: values
parameter.description: enumId, enumTypeId, description, enumCode, sequenceNum, useCount, ended, thruDateText, stateText, applicability (applicabilityId, classEnumId, productId, appliesText, fromDateText, thruDateText, current), appliesText, canEdit, canEnd, revision

service.description: A new value of one of Maintenance's vocabularies (its name, code and order), a value's new name, code or order, or its end (end true: from now; thruDate: from then, now or later, DATE_INVALID before): an ended value stays for the records that hold it and is offered for no new one; nothing is deleted. A failure mode also takes an applicability row (addClassEnumId, an asset class, or addProductId, a model; APPLICABILITY_INVALID for both, APPLICABILITY_EXISTS for one in effect) and ends one (endApplicabilityId). Refuses a caller without MAINTENANCE_SETTINGS_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), a family not Maintenance's (FAMILY_INVALID), a new or ended value of a fixed kind (FAMILY_FIXED), a value of another family (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no name (DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED), a name a current value of the family has (DUPLICATE_VALUE), an order that is not a whole number from 0 to 9999 (SEQUENCE_INVALID), an ended value (VALUE_ENDED) and, for a change of the value itself, a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

Maintenance's setup readiness, answering the framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider maintenance.readiness) with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId (or none, for each organization of the caller's scope that uses Maintenance: a work policy, a procedure, maintenance work or a preventive plan), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message, the organization as subject and scope, and for a check that is not ready its owner's place as a route key (fixRoute, with fixId where it names a record): approved procedures (maintenanceProcedures), an approver for each resource approved by people (maintenanceResources), a technician who may issue parts (adminGroups), the maintenance expense mapping (accountingPostingDefaults), a labor costing rate for each technician (accountingCostingPolicies), and the preventive generation job generate_MaintenanceWorkOrders: ready with no active plan, "not configured" while it is not there, paused, not run or failed (adminJob with the job's name). One check that fails is unavailable by name and the others go on. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without MAINTENANCE_SETTINGS_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).
